description: Resolve a gene, disease, chemical/drug, variant, species or cell-line name to its normalized PubTator 3 entity id (e.g. "BRCA1" -> @GENE_BRCA1, NCBI Gene 672; "breast cancer" -> @DISEASE_Breast_Neoplasms, MeSH D001943). Use the id with pubtator_search and pubtator_relations. Sourced from the PubTator 3 autocomplete index at NCBI/NLM, which normalizes to NCBI Gene, MeSH, LitVar/dbSNP and NCBI Taxonomy. Keyless.

concept.description: Restrict to one entity type. Omit to search all six. gene, disease, chemical and variant are densely covered; species and cellline autocomplete is sparse.

query.description: Name or synonym to look up, e.g. "BRCA1", "metformin", "breast cancer", "V600E".

name: pubtator_find_entity
title: Pubtator Find Entity
